html:
Hi all.  I know many of you are signed up for my free Beta Reader program.  For those other brave souls who are interested in reading the completed rough draft of Book One of The Rho Assimilation as soon as I have it ready to go, I’m taking sign-ups now.  If you are interested in being added to my Beta Readers list, send an email to me at Richard.Phillips@secondship.net

All I ask of my Beta Readers is to provide general feedback about what you thought of the draft and any egregious errors that really bugged you … my editor catches most but sometimes I make a mistake that only my Beta readers catch.  An example of this was my initial description of how the NSA’s quantum computer worked in DEAD WRONG, but I’ve also made significant changes to the initial draft based on general feedback.  It all helps.

By the way, anyone who is a past Beta Reader and would like to be removed from my list can also send me an email and I’ll remove you from my list.

Best
Richard
